question: What will be the maximum intraday value of the VIX over these biweekly periods in Q4 2026? (Nov 23 - Dec 4)

calls.reasoning: VIX closed 28.44 on Nov 19 (Cboe CSV) and is about 31.4 midday Nov 20 (high 31.75), its first move above 30 since March, amid an AI/chip selloff after Anthropic's IPO and six straight S&P down days. Window is Nov 23-Dec 4 (9 trading days, Thanksgiving closed). In past spike-regime Fridays chosen from memory (not a systematic scan), the next-2-week max high ran 1.0x to 1.35x the Friday close, median about 1.10x; Aug 2024 was an outlier at 2.8x. Dec/Jan futures were about 4 points below spot (backwardation) and Thanksgiving week usually quiets things, which argues for mean reversion and trims the median; the floor is Monday's high, likely in the high 20s. No human prediction market found (Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi searched).
